title: Agent Archivist verify-state result (archivist.cli-result/v1)
description: The result document of the `verify-state` command (plan Phase 5; CLI-015): one read-only consistency verification of the local state — the store's automated integrity checks, the spool's row-to-bundle correspondence, orphan bundle files a mutator's next reconciliation pass will index, and the receipt chain every acknowledged spool entry must have. Every figure is a content-free counter or a closed-vocabulary token; no field carries a path, a transcript body, a secret value or reference string, or an unbounded identifier (SEC-004, CFG-027). The command never repairs: reconciliation is the mutator's act, and this document is the evidence.

x-archivist.compatibility: member additions are additive within v1 per plan Section 7.1 (CLI-015); redefining or removing a member, or a new namespace, is a v2 event

schema.description: The CLI result namespace. Present in every result document so a consumer always knows which contract it is reading before anything else (VAL-001); an unknown namespace is not this format and fails closed.

generated_at.description: The instant the verification ran (plan Section 7.3).

verdict.description: The overall verdict: degraded when any named check failed. Stable and content-free, the same discipline the error classes pin.

counts.description: The evidence counts behind the check verdicts.

schema_objects.description: Every table and index the schema expects is present.

live_bundles_present.description: Every not-yet-acknowledged spool row's bundle file is on disk. A missing bundle is corruption (the bytes behind a live upload promise are gone); it is never repaired here.

acknowledged_receipted.description: Every acknowledged spool entry has a committed receipt through its frozen request: cleanup never runs ahead of the receipt transaction (plan Section 7.9).

check-verdicts.description: The named checks and their verdicts.

live_rows_missing_bundles.description: Live (not yet acknowledged) spool rows whose bundle file is missing.

orphan_bundle_files.description: Complete bundle files on disk with no spool row: the crash-between-rename-and-commit debris a mutator's next reconciliation pass indexes. Expected after a crash; never corruption.

acknowledged_entries_without_receipts.description: Acknowledged spool entries whose frozen request has no receipt row.
